mentions.name: Comet 67P dust particle motion modeling
mentions.description: Research effort modeling the motion of observed dust particles coming off of comet 67P, producing 3D visualizations of possible particle trajectories and working to determine possible orbits from a set of observations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on modeling the motion of observed dust particles coming off of comet 67P, here is are some example 3d plots:

Example of rocks ejected from one position and their possible motions:
https://dahlend.github.io/67p_beta_dust.html

Trying to determine possible orbits from a set of observations (the straight lines):
https://dahlend.github.io/67p_dust_orbit.html
